# SqueakyCleanText

> Production-ready text preprocessing and PII anonymization pipeline for Python 3.12+.
> Removes noise (URLs, emails, phone numbers, stopwords), detects language automatically,
> and runs ensemble NER (ONNX/PyTorch/GLiNER) for entity anonymization.
> Published on PyPI as `squeakycleantext`.

## Quick Start

```
pip install squeakycleantext
```

```python
from sct import TextCleaner, TextCleanerConfig

cleaner = TextCleaner(cfg=TextCleanerConfig(check_ner_process=True))
result = cleaner.process("Contact John at john@acme.com or +1-555-123-4567.")
lm_text, stat_text, lang = result  # backward-compatible 3-tuple unpacking
# lm_text:   "Contact <PERSON> at <EMAIL> or <PHONE>."
# stat_text: "contact"
# lang:      "ENGLISH"
```

## API Surface

- `TextCleaner(cfg=TextCleanerConfig(...))` — main pipeline class
- `cleaner.process(text) -> ProcessResult` — process single text (unpacks as 3-tuple)
- `cleaner.process_batch(texts) -> List[ProcessResult]` — thread-parallel batch
- `cleaner.aprocess_batch(texts) -> List[ProcessResult]` — async (FastAPI/aiohttp)
- `cleaner.warmup(languages=None)` — pre-load NER models at startup
- `ProcessResult.metadata` — always a dict: `regex_counts` and `entity_counts` (`{TYPE: {"count", "chars"}}`, value-free), `language_confidence` (float, 1.0 pinned, None unknown), `language_source` (`pinned`/`detected`/`fallback`/`none`), `warnings` (sorted codes: `language_unknown`, `language_fallback`, `language_low_confidence`, `ner_fallback_models`, `cuda_fallback`, `mps_fallback`), `provenance` (`{"backend", "models": [{"key", "id", "revision", "provider"}]}` of the NER models run), plus `anon_map` (reversible mode), `classes` (GLiClass), `findings` (opt-in)
- `ProcessResult.signals` — value-free view, same keys for every input: `language`, `language_confidence`, `language_source`, `chars`, `pii_count`, `pii_chars`, `pii_share`, `pii_types`, `regex_counts`, `entity_counts`, `sensitive`, `warnings` (adds `ner_off`, `empty_input`), `models`. Never entity text (`sct.signals.public_view`, `merge_views`, `PUBLIC_VIEW_KEYS`)
- `preset_config(name, **overrides)` / `TextCleanerConfig.from_preset(name, ...)` / `PRESETS` — `"training"` (PII only) or `"sct"` (library defaults)
- `sct.adapters.is_sensitive_result(result)` — True when any regex replacement or NER finding was counted
- `AnonymizationMap.deanonymize(text)` — restore original text from reversible placeholders
- `AnonymizationMap.to_dict()` / `.from_dict(data)` — serialization for storage
- `sct.evaluation.evaluate_pii(examples, predictions, model=...)` — exact-span PII evaluation
- `EvaluationReport` — overall metrics plus label, language, domain, and slice metrics
- `PrivacyPolicy` / `EntityRule` — versioned entity actions and score thresholds
- `TokenStore` — external storage boundary for reversible token maps
- `process_json` / `process_dataframe` / `process_rag_chunks` — boundary adapters
- `BufferedStreamingRedactor` / `WindowedStreamingRedactor` — streaming interfaces
- `redact_image` / `TesseractOCRProvider` — optional OCR image redaction
- `assess_reidentification_risk` — corpus k-anonymity summary
- `MODEL_CANDIDATES` / `run_model_benchmark` — pinned model evaluation
- `sct.integrations.hf.clean_dataset(ds, columns=, output=, config=, score=, **map_kwargs)` — Hugging Face datasets (`[datasets]` extra)
- `sct.integrations.datatrove.SCTCleaner` / `sct.integrations.langchain.SCTDocumentTransformer` / `sct.integrations.haystack.SCTDocumentCleaner` — framework adapters (`[datatrove]`, `[langchain]`, `[haystack]`); shared options `columns`, `output='overwrite'|'new_column'`, `config` (default `"training"` preset); write `metadata["sct"]`
- `sct.integrations._runtime.CleanerHandle` / `clean_columns` — one cleaner per process for Ray, Spark, Polars, DuckDB, dlt, Daft (docs/RECIPES.md)
- `sct.score.score_record(result)` / `score_records(results, texts, ScoreConfig(...))` — flat `sct_*` columns; Score B (quality, MinHash, `[score]` extra) off by default; `build_data_card` / `render_data_card`

## PII Evaluation

Use the evaluation harness before changing a default model:

```
python -m scripts.evaluate_pii \
  --dataset evaluation/pii_starter.jsonl \
  --predictions path/to/model-predictions.jsonl \
  --model model-name-and-revision \
  --output evaluation/results/model-name.json
```

The starter corpus is a synthetic smoke fixture, not evidence for accuracy or
compliance claims. See `evaluation/README.md` for the JSONL schemas and release rules.

Benchmark a pinned model candidate:

```
python -m scripts.benchmark_models \
  --dataset evaluation/pii_starter.jsonl \
  --candidate gliner2-pii \
  --output evaluation/results/gliner2-pii.json
```

## Privacy Policies and Audit Metadata

Pass `privacy_policy=PrivacyPolicy(...)` and `include_entities=True` to
`TextCleaner`. `ProcessResult.metadata` then includes policy findings; model
revisions are always in `metadata['provenance']`.

Pass `token_store=...` in reversible mode to return an opaque
`anon_map_reference` instead of the map. Reversible output remains
pseudonymized personal data.

## Boundary Commands

```
printf 'Email maria@example.com' | sct-clean --no-ner --preset training
sct-report data.jsonl --text-column text --preset training --minhash \
    --quasi-identifiers city,age_band --k 5 --out report.json --card card.md
pip install 'squeakycleantext[mcp]'
SCT_MCP_PRESET=training SCT_MCP_ROOT=~/notes sct-mcp
```

FastMCP loads only when the MCP server starts. MCP tools `clean_text` (`text` or `path`)
and `clean_json` return `{warnings, summary, text|value, signals}`, plus value-free
`findings` with `detail="full"`. `path` input is off unless `SCT_MCP_ROOT` is set
(`SCT_MCP_MAX_BYTES`, default 1 MiB). `SCT_MCP_PRESET` defaults to `sct`. OCR requires the `ocr` extra and
a local Tesseract executable when using `TesseractOCRProvider`.

## TextCleanerConfig — Key Fields

Presets: `preset_config("training", **overrides)` / `TextCleanerConfig.from_preset()` = PII-only cleaning
for training/RAG text (URLs, emails, phones, IPs, NER entities replaced; numbers, dates, HTML,
brackets, case, punctuation, whitespace, code escapes kept; no stat_text). `"sct"` = library defaults.
Adapters default to `"training"`.

```
check_ner_process=True              # NER entity anonymization
check_replace_urls=True             # Replace URLs with <URL>
check_decode_unicode_escapes=True   # With check_fix_bad_unicode: decode literal \u00e9 / \n escapes; False keeps them (code)
check_replace_emails=True           # Replace emails with <EMAIL>
check_replace_ips=True              # Replace IPv4/IPv6 with <IP> (replace_ips_public_only=False)
check_replace_phone_numbers=True    # Replace phones with <PHONE>
phone_reject_embedded=True          # Digit-only phone inside a longer token (ID9876543210) or a bare yyyymmdd date/timestamp is not a phone; False = 0.8.1
check_replace_numbers=True          # Replace numbers with <NUMBER>
replace_numbers_mode='identifiers'  # Only whole identifier-shaped digit runs (no amounts, %, times, ranges, code parts); 'all' = 0.8.1
replace_numbers_min_digits=4        # Fewest digits for 'identifiers' mode
numbers_letter_prefix_ids=True      # 'identifiers' mode: AB1234567 (1-3 uppercase + 6+ digits) is one <NUMBER>
numbers_two_part_ids=True           # 'identifiers' mode: 123456/7890, 12345-678901, 12345.67890 are one <NUMBER> (not 2023-2024, 1000-3000)
numbers_spaced_pair_ids=True        # 'identifiers' mode: '123 45' (spaced postal code) and spaced/mixed IDs '123 45 6789', '123 45-6789' (3+ groups, 7+ digits) are one <NUMBER>; '1 234 567' and dates stay
check_replace_dates=True            # Replace dates with <DATE>
check_fuzzy_replace_dates=False     # Fuzzy misspelled month matching (requires [fuzzy])
check_remove_stopwords=True         # Language-aware stopword removal
check_remove_punctuation=True       # Punctuation removal (stat output)
check_remove_emoji=False            # Remove emoji characters
check_statistical_model_processing=True  # Generate stat_text output
check_classify_document=False       # GLiClass zero-shot pre-classification

ner_backend='onnx'                  # 'onnx'|'torch'|'gliner'|'ensemble_onnx'|'ensemble_torch'|'presidio_gliner'
ner_mode='standard'                 # 'standard'|'pii' (auto-configures GLiNER for 60+ PII entity types)
replacement_mode='placeholder'      # 'placeholder' | 'synthetic' | 'reversible' (indexed placeholders + deanonymize map)
ner_confidence_threshold=None       # Min confidence (0..1); None = 0.85, or the GLiNER threshold in PII mode
gliner_threshold=None               # GLiNER cut (0..1); None = 0.4, or 0.3 in PII mode
ner_batch_size=8                    # NER chunks per forward pass, batched across process_batch docs; 1 = 0.7.1 pattern
onnx_intra_op_threads=None          # ONNX Runtime threads per inference (None = ORT default, all cores); set to cap CPU use
onnx_inter_op_threads=None          # ONNX Runtime inter-op threads (None = ORT default; rarely needed)
ner_device=None                     # None = auto (CUDA when available) | 'cpu' | 'cuda'
cuda_device_id=0                    # GPU index for ONNX/torch/GLiNER (and GLiClass with ner_device='cuda')
onnx_cuda_provider_options=None     # extra CUDAExecutionProvider options, e.g. {'gpu_mem_limit': 8 << 30}
ner_chunk_overlap=0                 # NER window overlap in tokens per side for long docs (0 = 0.7.1 chunks)
detect_all_languages=True           # Auto-detect over all 75 Lingua languages; False = 0.7 detector (EN/NL/DE/ES + extras)
json_key_cleaning='pii'             # process_json keys: 'pii' = regex PII steps only (no NER) | 'pii_ner' = plus NER | 'full' = whole config (0.7) | 'off' = raw
language_confidence_warning=0.0     # metadata warning 'language_low_confidence' below this confidence (0..1, never changes routing)
language_margin_warning=0.15        # same warning when the top language leads the runner-up by less than this
positional_tags=('PER','LOC','ORG','MISC')

gliner_model=None                   # GLiNER model ID (auto-set by ner_mode='pii')
gliner_onnx=False                   # Load GLiNER with ONNX weights (auto-set for PII + onnx backend)
gliner_label_descriptions=None      # ZERONER-style: {'person': "a person's full name"} for zero-shot
gliclass_model=None                 # GLiClass model ID (default: gliclass-edge-v3.0)
gliclass_labels=()                  # Classification labels: ('email', 'code', 'legal')
language=None                       # Pin ('en', 'hi': any Lingua language), restrict (('en','nl')), or None for auto-detect. Accepts Lingua names, ISO 639-1/639-3.
extra_languages=()                  # Add languages: 'FRENCH', 'fr', 'PORTUGUESE', 'pt', etc.
custom_stopwords=None               # {LANG: frozenset({...})}
custom_deny_terms=None              # {LABEL: ('term', ...)}: always mask as <LABEL> (whole word, Unicode-aware); runs before built-in regex
custom_allow_terms=()               # ('term', ...): never mask (regex and NER), applied last
custom_patterns=None                # {LABEL: r'regex'} (regex module): mask matches as <LABEL>; empty-matching patterns rejected
custom_terms_case_sensitive=False   # Case rule for deny/allow terms
custom_patterns_timeout=2.0         # Seconds per custom pattern per document (ReDoS guard); None = no limit
custom_patterns_on_timeout='raise'  # 'raise' CustomPatternTimeout (label only) | 'warn': log, warning 'custom_pattern_timeout', skip pattern
custom_pipeline_steps=()            # Tuple of (text: str) -> str callables
```

## NER Backends

```
onnx (default)    — ONNX Runtime, torch-free, ~3-5x faster than PyTorch — base install
torch             — PyTorch/Transformers pipeline — pip install squeakycleantext[torch]
gliner            — Zero-shot custom entities, PII mode, bi-encoder — pip install squeakycleantext[gliner]
ensemble_onnx     — ONNX + GLiNER voting — pip install squeakycleantext[gliner]
ensemble_torch    — Torch + GLiNER voting — pip install squeakycleantext[torch,gliner]
presidio_gliner   — Presidio + GLiNER recognizer (beta) — pip install presidio-analyzer squeakycleantext[gliner]
```

## Replacement Modes

```
placeholder (default)  — Entities become <TAG> tokens: "John" → "<PERSON>"
synthetic              — Faker-generated values: "John" → "Robert Chen" (pip install squeakycleantext[synthetic])
reversible             — Indexed placeholders: "John" → "<PERSON_0>" with AnonymizationMap for round-trip restore
```

## Supported Languages

```
English                        — rhnfzl/xlm-roberta-large-conll03-english-onnx
Dutch                          — rhnfzl/xlm-roberta-large-conll02-dutch-onnx
German                         — rhnfzl/xlm-roberta-large-conll03-german-onnx
Spanish                        — rhnfzl/xlm-roberta-large-conll02-spanish-onnx
French / Portuguese / Italian  — rhnfzl/wikineural-multilingual-ner-onnx (shared ONNX session)
```

## Common Q&A

**Q: How do I anonymize PII in text?**
A: Set `check_ner_process=True` (default). Returns entities replaced with `<PERSON>`, `<ORGANISATION>`, `<LOCATION>`.

**Q: How do I detect comprehensive PII (emails, SSNs, credit cards, etc.)?**
A: Use `TextCleanerConfig(ner_mode='pii')`. Auto-configures GLiNER with 60+ PII entity labels.

**Q: How do I get realistic fake values instead of <TAG> tokens?**
A: Use `TextCleanerConfig(replacement_mode='synthetic')`. Requires `pip install squeakycleantext[synthetic]`.

**Q: How do I get reversible anonymization with a deanonymize map?**
A: Use `TextCleanerConfig(replacement_mode='reversible')`. Access the map via `result.metadata['anon_map']`.

**Q: How do I classify documents before processing?**
A: Use `TextCleanerConfig(check_classify_document=True, gliclass_labels=('email', 'code'))`. Requires `pip install squeakycleantext[classify]`.

**Q: How do I use bi-encoder GLiNER models with longer context?**
A: Just specify the model: `TextCleanerConfig(ner_backend='gliner', gliner_model='knowledgator/gliner-bi-base-v2.0')`. Bi-encoder is auto-detected.

**Q: How do I process texts in a FastAPI route without blocking the event loop?**
A: Use: `results = await cleaner.aprocess_batch(texts)`

**Q: How do I pre-load models to avoid first-request latency?**
A: Call `cleaner.warmup(['ENGLISH', 'DUTCH'])` during application startup.

**Q: How do I add French/Portuguese/Italian support?**
A: Pass `extra_languages=('FRENCH',)` in `TextCleanerConfig`. NER and detection both route via the multilingual model automatically.

**Q: Can I add custom text transformation steps?**
A: Yes — `custom_pipeline_steps=(my_fn,)` where `my_fn` accepts and returns `str`. Steps run after all built-in steps.

**Q: How do I clean a Hugging Face dataset or a LangChain/Haystack/DataTrove pipeline?**
A: Use the adapters in `sct.integrations` (see docs/INTEGRATIONS.md). They default to the `training` preset (PII only).

**Q: How do I get per-row PII stats or a data card without exposing values?**
A: `sct.score.score_record(result)` or the `sct-report` command (docs/SCORE.md).

**Q: How fast is it, and should I use a GPU?**
A: See docs/PERFORMANCE.md: `process_batch` with about 16 workers on CPU; a GPU for bulk work.

**Q: What's the difference between lm_text and stat_text?**
A: `lm_text` preserves sentence structure with replacement tokens (for LLM fine-tuning/inference). `stat_text` is lowercased, stopword-free, no punctuation (for TF-IDF, embeddings, classical ML).

## Key Source Files

```
sct/sct.py                       — TextCleaner orchestrator, pipeline assembly
sct/config.py                    — TextCleanerConfig frozen dataclass, all defaults
sct/utils/ner.py                 — GeneralNER: ensemble NER, lazy loading, ONNX session sharing
sct/utils/gliner_adapter.py      — GLiNERAdapter: bi-encoder support, label embedding cache
sct/utils/gliclass_adapter.py    — GLiClassAdapter: zero-shot document classification
sct/utils/anonymization_map.py   — AnonymizationMap: reversible anonymization mapping
sct/utils/process_result.py      — ProcessResult: backward-compatible result with metadata
sct/utils/synthetic.py           — SyntheticReplacer: Faker-based entity replacement
sct/utils/onnx_pipeline.py       — ONNXNERPipeline: ONNX inference, BIO aggregation
sct/signals.py                   — public value-free view (ProcessResult.signals)
sct/presets.py                   — training / sct presets
sct/integrations/                — HF datasets, DataTrove, LangChain, Haystack adapters
sct/score.py / sct/report_cli.py — score columns, data card, sct-report
sct/mcp_server.py                — FastMCP server (sct-mcp)
sct/utils/constants.py           — Pre-compiled regexes (URL, email, phone, date, currency, etc.)
sct/utils/stopwords.py           — Language-aware stopword removal (O(1) set lookup)
sct/utils/resources.py           — Lingua language detector (lazy singleton)
tests/test_sct.py                — Full test suite (hypothesis, faker, pytest-timeout)
```
